item.aezyn.description: Slender bracers of black metal with glowing violet lines running toward the wrist.
item.aezyn.lore: The glow answers whenever an arrow is drawn. Whoever made them left no mark, and the bracers do not offer one.
item.aezyn.name: Veinlight Bracers
item.aezyn.unique: Magic Arrow damage scaling increases by 666%.
item.ammo_can_quiver.description: An olive-drab ammunition can cut open at the top, with a rifle sling riveted to the side.
item.ammo_can_quiver.lore: The lid still seals. Your arrows stay dry, and the rattle when you run sounds like someone who means it.
item.ammo_can_quiver.name: Ammo Can Quiver
item.ancient_scroll.description: Brittle, yellowed ledger pages covered in tight script that crackles when unfolded.
item.ancient_scroll.lore: It predates the resort, the bunkers, and probably the island's name. The first line is a single word: burn.
item.ancient_scroll.name: Ledger of Ash
item.anger.description: A long sword with a blade the color of old blood and a grip wrapped in wet leather.
item.anger.lore: It remembers every hand that held it, and none of them let go willingly.
item.anger.name: Scarlet Grasp
item.anger.unique: Raises your maximum Frenzy stacks by 15.
item.archangel.description: A white greatbow with feathered limbs and a gentle, honest glow.
item.archangel.lore: Built by a man who thought he could mend a squad's wounds with the right arrow. Aim at an ally and the bow cooperates.
item.archangel.name: Suture Bow
item.archangel.unique: Shooting another player empowers them for 30 seconds.
item.ash_rosary.description: A string of grey beads pressed from compacted cremation ash.
item.ash_rosary.lore: Count the beads and you will always come up one short. The cult says that bead is yours.
item.ash_rosary.name: Ash Bead Cord
item.atomic_augmentation.description: Heavy boots with a faintly glowing core in each heel, ticking like a Geiger counter.
item.atomic_augmentation.lore: A bunker experiment that was supposed to make soldiers faster. It definitely made them something.
item.atomic_augmentation.name: Oathbound Treads
item.atomic_augmentation.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.axe_of_swiftness.description: A lean axe with a wind-worn haft and a blade ground thin as paper.
item.axe_of_swiftness.lore: Cut from a tribal hunter's belt after a chase that ended before he saw the swing. It remembers the hurry.
item.axe_of_swiftness.name: Swiftedge Hatchet
item.black_hammer.description: A massive war hammer of blackened steel with a head the size of a loaf of bread.
item.black_hammer.lore: It has crushed shields, kneecaps and at least one wall. It is never clean, and it has never needed to be.
item.black_hammer.name: Coalhead Sledge
item.black_hammer.unique: Hits slow the enemy they strike.
item.bloodthirster.description: A long sword of dark steel with a narrow channel running down the center of the blade.
item.bloodthirster.lore: The channel is there for a reason, and the reason is plain. It never stays clean for more than a moment.
item.bloodthirster.name: Veinrunner
item.bloodthirster.unique: Bash heals you and restores energy equal to 2% of damage dealt.
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.desc: A greatsword with the edge ground off and the flat studded with iron nails.
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.lore: Made for people who never wanted to cut anything, only to be loud about it.
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.name: Dullthunder
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.uniq: Bash's damage-taken debuff on enemies increases by 200%.
item.bonebound_bracer.description: Split rib bones bound over a cuff of boiled leather with waxed cord.
item.bonebound_bracer.lore: The bones were not from anything you would eat. You try not to think about which camp they came from.
item.bonebound_bracer.name: Bonebound Bracer
item.bonecrusher_knuckles.description: Heavy gloves with iron knuckle plates sewn over each finger.
item.bonecrusher_knuckles.lore: Every swing hits like a dropped anvil.
item.bonecrusher_knuckles.name: Bonecrusher Knuckles
item.broken_flip_flops.description: A pair of sun-bleached flip-flops, one strap snapped and tied back with a knot.
item.broken_flip_flops.lore: Left behind by someone who packed for a beach holiday. The island has had opinions about that ever since.
item.broken_flip_flops.name: Snapped Sandals
item.broken_leather_shoulder_armor.descr: A ripped leather shoulder pad with a missing strap and sweat-stained padding.
item.broken_leather_shoulder_armor.lore: It cushions one shoulder and insults the other. Better than a bare shoulder, which the island is always eager to bite.
item.broken_leather_shoulder_armor.name: Cracked Hide Pad
item.broken_loop.description: A bent metal ring that no longer closes, with a dull gleam in the dent.
item.broken_loop.lore: Probably a keyring once, or a curtain ring, or a cheap promise. You wear it anyway because rings tend to pay back.
item.broken_loop.name: Bent Curtain Ring
item.broken_shield.description: A splintered plank of a shield with a cracked handle and half its rim missing.
item.broken_shield.lore: It stopped one blow and was rewarded with retirement. You are asking it to do a little more than that.
item.broken_shield.name: Splintered Plank
item.bunker_flak_vest.description: A grey military vest with a stencilled serial number, its plates still seated in their pockets.
item.bunker_flak_vest.lore: Issued to a guard who never left the bunker. The vest outlived the guard, which is the whole job description.
item.bunker_flak_vest.name: Bunker Flak Vest
item.censer_gloves.description: Heavy leather gloves with chains and a tiny smoking brazier dangling from each wrist.
item.censer_gloves.lore: The smoke smells like pine and burnt hair. Wearers report calmer thoughts and a worrying lack of appetite.
item.censer_gloves.name: Smudge-Pot Gloves
item.charcoal_cave_notes.description: Pages of diagrams rubbed in charcoal from a cave wall, folded into a plastic sleeve.
item.charcoal_cave_notes.lore: The marks repeat in a pattern nobody taught the person who drew them. Reading them makes your fingertips buzz.
item.charcoal_cave_notes.name: Charcoal Cave Notes
item.chastity_belt.description: A heavy iron belt with a rusted lock and no key in sight.
item.chastity_belt.lore: Found in a resort suite, which raises more questions than it answers. It is oddly comfortable for a night in the dirt.
item.chastity_belt.name: Rustlock Girdle
item.chastity_belt.unique: You take 100% less damage while sleeping.
item.cloth_pants.description: Plain cloth pants, patched at the knee with a different color of cloth.
item.cloth_pants.lore: Not armor in any real sense, but the island's dignity only goes as far as you let it, and these are a start.
item.cloth_pants.name: Patched Trousers
item.clubhouse_visor.description: A white sun visor with a monogram, a bullet graze, and a faint scent of sunscreen.
item.clubhouse_visor.lore: Members only. The membership card is still in the band, along with a handwritten note: 'Do not let them see you sweat.'
item.clubhouse_visor.name: Clubhouse Visor
item.cripplers.description: Black leather gloves studded with sharp, mismatched fish hooks along the knuckles.
item.cripplers.lore: The seams are stained from the inside. The previous owner liked to watch targets stumble, and it shows in the wear.
item.cripplers.name: Gaffhook Gloves
item.cripplers.unique: Magic arrow debuffs last 15 seconds longer.
item.crossfire.description: A scorched leather quiver stitched with crossed arrows and charred along the rim.
item.crossfire.lore: The cult used to hang these on poles as warnings. Run past one and you can swear the arrows rearranged themselves behind you.
item.crossfire.name: The Hung Quiver
item.crossfire.unique: Projectile hits spawn a free magic arrow aimed at the target, at most once every 2 seconds; cooldown reduction shortens that gap.
item.cube_fragment_pendant.description: A shard of impossible black glass wrapped in copper wire, always slightly colder than the room.
item.cube_fragment_pendant.lore: Hold it up to the light and it throws a shadow that faces the wrong way.
item.cube_fragment_pendant.name: Cube Fragment Pendant
item.cube_fragment_pendant.unique: Blink detonates where you arrive, and its blast deals 2 more times spell damage.
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.description: A rolled strip of tanned skin covered in tight, rhythmic script.
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.lore: Read it aloud and the lights go out. Read it silently and the lights come back on, a few at a time, in the wrong rooms.
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.name: Cult Ritual Chant
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.unique: Black Hole lasts 4 s longer, has +5 m radius and +10 pull force.
item.cultists_bone_epaulets.description: Fanned rib bones lashed to leather straps, painted with a faded eye.
item.cultists_bone_epaulets.lore: A mark of rank in the cult. The higher you climb, the more ribs you are missing.
item.cultists_bone_epaulets.name: Cultist's Bone Epaulets
item.curse_hammer.description: A black iron hammer covered in scratched warding symbols that did not work.
item.curse_hammer.lore: Every hand that held it learned how to hate. The symbols were not a warning; they were a recipe.
item.curse_hammer.name: Scrawlward Maul
item.curse_hammer.unique: Adds +45% chance to weaken enemies on hit.
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.description: A ring of keys to every room in the resort, all of them labeled 'DO NOT USE.'
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.lore: Every door opens, but it never opens onto the room you wanted. Occasionally it opens onto loot.
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.name: Cursed Resort Key Ring
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.unique: +25% magic find, but enemies are 10% more likely to land hits on you.
item.damaged_bracer.description: A cracked leather wrist guard held together with wire and optimism.
item.damaged_bracer.lore: It has taken more hits than anyone wearing it should admit. It will take a few more before it joins the others in the snow.
item.damaged_bracer.name: Wired Wrist Guard
item.damaged_leather_boots.description: Scuffed leather boots, torn at the toe but still holding a decent stride.
item.damaged_leather_boots.lore: Cut from a hide that was never meant to be shoes. They squeak in the snow, which the cannibals find hilarious right up until they don't.
item.damaged_leather_boots.name: Scuffed Hide Boots
item.death_pact.description: Blood-red pauldrons carved with a ring of skulls, their eye sockets weeping fresh wax.
item.death_pact.lore: A deal is a deal. The more it costs you, the harder you hit back, and the pauldrons are very good at keeping count.
item.death_pact.name: Skullbond Pauldrons
item.death_pact.unique: Each attack costs 7% of your max health, though it cannot kill you; you gain 5% damage for every 1% of health you are missing.
item.drovers_breeches.description: Thick riding breeches, patched at the knee and lined with fleece.
item.drovers_breeches.lore: Made for long days on the move. They have had plenty.
item.drovers_breeches.name: Drover's Breeches
item.duelists_buckler.description: A small round buckler, light enough to swing with.
item.duelists_buckler.lore: Meant for turning blades, not stopping them.
item.duelists_buckler.name: Duelist's Buckler
item.dull_longsword.description: A machete with a chipped, rounded edge that has seen far more use than care.
item.dull_longsword.lore: Sharp enough to be rude, dull enough to be bad at it. It remains a blade, and a blade is more than a stick.
item.dull_longsword.name: Blunt Machete
item.ember_mask.description: A bone-white mask whose eyeholes glow like coals.
item.ember_mask.lore: It never cools. The tribes say it holds a dying star, and the star is very hungry.
item.ember_mask.name: Coalgaze Mask
item.ember_mask.unique: Ignited enemies burn 700% longer, and burn damage ticks 300% faster.
item.eruption.description: A greatbow of volcanic glass and dark wood, hot to the touch.
item.eruption.lore: Carved from a rock that exploded when it was cut. The bow has never seen a target it did not want to crack open.
item.eruption.name: Slagfire Bow
item.eyepatch.description: A black cloth eyepatch with a fraying strap and a small brass stud.
item.eyepatch.lore: A survivor's second-best option after losing the first. It makes you look tough and feel nothing, which is how it was meant.
item.eyepatch.name: Black Patch
item.eyepatch.unique: Explosion damage also applies when you perform jump attacks.
item.factory_quiver.description: A sleek, matte-black quiver stamped with a serial number and a bunker logo.
item.factory_quiver.lore: Printed in one piece at a 3D fabricator deep in the complex. The ammo feeder was not part of the original design.
item.factory_quiver.name: Printed Polymer Quiver
item.factory_quiver.unique: 40% chance not to consume ammo when firing a projectile.
item.finger_warmer.description: A knitted fingerless mitt with one thumb hole chewed bigger than the rest.
item.finger_warmer.lore: Warm enough for a pilot's hands and useless against everything else. Still better than frostbite, which takes fingers just as thoroughly as the locals do.
item.finger_warmer.name: Frayed Knitmitts
item.fire_hardened_spear.description: A straight sapling sharpened to a point and baked in a campfire.
item.fire_hardened_spear.lore: Humanity's first technology. It still works.
item.fire_hardened_spear.name: Fire-Hardened Spear
item.fists_of_nails.description: Heavy gloves with long rusted nails hammered through the knuckles from the inside out.
item.fists_of_nails.lore: The wearer never explained how they put them on. Everyone nearby agreed it was not a topic to push.
item.fists_of_nails.name: Tenpenny Fists
item.fists_of_nails.unique: You gain 9 thorns per point of vitality.
item.flame_pauldrons.description: Charred steel pauldrons with ever-burning brass vents on the shoulder.
item.flame_pauldrons.lore: Built to turn heat into fury. The inner lining is mostly scar tissue now.
item.flame_pauldrons.name: Emberforge Pauldrons
item.flame_pauldrons.unique: Firebolt costs 5 more energy and its damage scaling increases by 7.5.
item.fletchers_guard.description: A hardened bracer worn on the bow arm, grooved where the string slaps.
item.fletchers_guard.lore: Every groove is a shot that went where it was meant to.
item.fletchers_guard.name: Fletcher's Guard
item.frost_giant.description: A massive hammer with an ice-crusted head the size of a boot.
item.frost_giant.lore: Carried down from the peaks by a mutant that had apparently been standing in a glacier. It never thaws, and neither does the grudge.
item.frost_giant.name: Deepfreeze Maul
item.frost_giant.unique: Hammer hits freeze enemies instead of stunning them, and the freeze lasts twice as long.
item.frostbound_wristguard.description: A wristguard of riveted plates rimed with frost that never quite melts.
item.frostbound_wristguard.lore: Pulled off a frozen hand on the northern ridge. The hand had been holding on to something that was no longer there.
item.frostbound_wristguard.name: Frostbound Wristguard
item.frozen_kite_shield.description: A shield caked with permafrost that does not melt, even near fire.
item.frozen_kite_shield.lore: Dug out of a drift. The winter that left it behind is not finished with you.
item.frozen_kite_shield.name: Ice-Caked Shield
item.frozen_kite_shield.unique: Blizzard slows you less, magic damage taken is 15% lower, Snap Freeze lasts 3 s longer.
item.gliderwing_mantle.description: Stiff ribbed fabric stretched across a shoulder frame, scavenged from a wrecked glider.
item.gliderwing_mantle.lore: It does not make you fly. It makes you believe, for a few seconds, that you could.
item.gliderwing_mantle.name: Gliderwing Mantle
item.gliderwing_mantle.unique: +1.5 jump power, +15% movement speed and +10 m Blink range.
item.golden_cuirass.description: A suit of gleaming golden plate, strangely light and lined with a sweet-smelling resin.
item.golden_cuirass.lore: Whoever forged it never needed a forge. The seams hum softly in the dark, as though the metal were counting.
item.golden_cuirass.name: Golden Cuirass
item.golden_gauntlets.description: Fingered gold gauntlets, impossibly smooth and just a little too warm to hold.
item.golden_gauntlets.lore: The old tales say gold does not tarnish. They fail to mention that it does not forget, either.
item.golden_gauntlets.name: Golden Gauntlets
item.golden_greaves.description: Segmented golden leg plates that chime softly with every step.
item.golden_greaves.lore: Walking in them feels like being carried. You feel less like a survivor and more like a procession.
item.golden_greaves.name: Golden Greaves
item.golden_pauldrons.description: Sculpted golden shoulder guards shaped like closed eyelids.
item.golden_pauldrons.lore: They do not blink. If you stare long enough, you start to wonder who is wearing whom.
item.golden_pauldrons.name: Golden Pauldrons
item.golden_ring.description: A plain gold band, warm to the touch even in the snow.
item.golden_ring.lore: A resort guest's wedding ring, according to the engraving. Their finger did not come with it.
item.golden_ring.name: Honeymoon Band
item.golden_visage.description: A blank, polished golden mask that reflects only the face of the person who is about to die.
item.golden_visage.lore: Found sealed in a case under the hills, a warm hand-print still on the glass. Taking it off feels like telling the island you give up.
item.golden_visage.name: Golden Visage
item.gps_locator_visor.description: A sleek bunker-issue visor that paints a shaky green grid over everything it sees.
item.gps_locator_visor.lore: Every enemy gets a little crosshair and a timestamp. The timestamps are all in the near future.
item.gps_locator_visor.name: GPS Locator Visor
item.grapplers_grips.description: Fingerless gloves with rope-wrapped palms for a fast, sure hold.
item.grapplers_grips.lore: Hold on, let go, hold on again. Faster each time.
item.grapplers_grips.name: Grappler's Grips
item.greater_mutated_heart.description: A fat, pulsing heart the size of a fist, wrapped in veins that twitch on their own.
item.greater_mutated_heart.lore: It beat in something that should not have lived. Whatever it was changed along the way, and the change is now yours if you can stomach it.
item.greater_mutated_heart.name: The Writhing Heart
item.greater_mutated_heart.unique: Right-click to consume it and gain permanent perk points.
item.greed.description: Gold-plated boots with spiked toes and a cheap, tacky shine.
item.greed.lore: Pulled off a resort investor who kept grabbing for more and finally reached too far. The boots still do.
item.greed.name: Gildspike Boots
item.greed.unique: Automatically casts Wide Reach once every second.
item.grip_of_sora.description: Slim bracers of woven cord and steel clasps, built to hold a bow steady.
item.grip_of_sora.lore: A hunter's tools, found with the owner's hands still in them. The cord is fresh. The hands are not.
item.grip_of_sora.name: Steadyhold Bracers
item.grip_of_sora.unique: Multishot costs 20% less energy and fires 4 extra projectiles, and the extras add no energy cost.
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.descript: A thick, hand-bound manual with diagrams of folded space.
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.lore: Written by someone who believed distance was a suggestion. The last chapter is mostly crossed out and underlined.
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.name: The Bent Atlas
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.unique: Blink creates an explosion where you arrive, with damage scaling with your speed and radius scaling with the blink distance.
item.hammer_jammers.description: Armored trousers with metal plates along the thighs and a pair of hammer loops at the belt.
item.hammer_jammers.lore: A craftsman's joke made real: they make you bring the hammer down harder and then hold the line when the dust settles.
item.hammer_jammers.name: Hammerhold Greaves
item.hammer_jammers.unique: Smash attacks deal 4.5 times damage, and your hammer stun duration is doubled.
item.hand_of_the_cube.description: A gauntlet of seamless dark metal, covered in angles that don't quite add up.
item.hand_of_the_cube.lore: It fits every hand. It fits no one. Look at it for too long and your fingers feel like a different shape.
item.hand_of_the_cube.name: Hand of the Cube
item.hand_of_the_cube.unique: Spells recharge 20% faster and cost 15% less, but maximum health is 15% lower.
item.haulers_brigandine.description: Canvas coat lined with riveted steel plates cut from a cargo box.
item.haulers_brigandine.lore: Built to carry loads. Turns out it carries blows just as well.
item.haulers_brigandine.name: Hauler's Brigandine
item.heart_of_purity.description: A clear, softly glowing heart, free of any blemish or mutation, beating without a body.
item.heart_of_purity.lore: Everything on this island is tainted, which makes this the strangest thing you have found. It pulses slowly, as though waiting for permission.
item.heart_of_purity.name: Clearpulse Heart
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.description: Charcoal-black pants stitched with a thin, unfriendly thread that wriggles under your gaze.
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.lore: Their last owner never stopped walking, because the pants never let him. They have a sharp opinion on loitering and no patience at all for sitting.
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.name: Ceaseless Trousers
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.unique: While moving you gain 40% more energy regeneration and damage. After standing still for over a second you lose 1% of max health per second.
item.hide_takers_gloves.description: Fingerless leather gloves with skinning blades stitched along the knuckles.
item.hide_takers_gloves.lore: The pelts stay on the hooks until the island hands them back, uncomfortable and full of opinions.
item.hide_takers_gloves.name: Hide-Taker's Gloves
item.hollow_congregant_cowl.description: A grey linen cowl with the eyes stitched shut from the inside.
item.hollow_congregant_cowl.lore: Members wear it to stop looking at the world. Whoever sewed these shut was thorough, and apparently left-handed.
item.hollow_congregant_cowl.name: Hushed Cowl
item.hollow_log.description: A hollowed-out tree trunk fitted with a leather strap, packed with fletched arrows.
item.hollow_log.lore: The bark is still on. Something small and furious lived in it before you, and some of that mood lingers in the shots you take.
item.hollow_log.name: Stumphollow Quiver
item.hood.description: A coarse dark hood stitched from burlap and wool, deep enough to hide a face.
item.hood.lore: Survivors favor these for staying inconspicuous. Unfortunately, so do the cannibals.
item.hood.name: Burlap Cowl
item.hood.unique: Like all headgear, it carries stat bonuses.
item.ice_scroll.description: Frost-rimed pages whose ink creeps across the paper like slow ice.
item.ice_scroll.lore: Dug out of a frozen cave where the walls sweat cold. The last reader is still in there, politely standing very still.
item.ice_scroll.name: Rimeink Pages
item.ice_scroll.unique: Snap Freeze deals more damage and its slow lasts 2 seconds longer.
item.inkstained_cuff.description: A leather cuff covered in tiny scratched sigils, smudged with charcoal.
item.inkstained_cuff.lore: Its owner wrote spells where they could not lose them.
item.inkstained_cuff.name: Inkstained Cuff
item.inkwell_ring.description: A ring with a tiny glass well set in it, half full of black ink.
item.inkwell_ring.lore: The ink never dries and never spills. Writers find that suspicious.
item.inkwell_ring.name: Inkwell Ring
item.jagged_edge.description: An axe with a saw-toothed blade, every tooth a different shape and size.
item.jagged_edge.lore: Made by a butcher who saw no reason to be neat. It leaves wounds that do not stop talking.
item.jagged_edge.name: Butcher's Rasp
item.jagged_edge.unique: Bash has a 30% chance to make enemies bleed for 30% of the damage dealt per second, lasting as long as the slow.
item.keycard_bracer.description: A wrist rig of clipped-together keycards, most of them for doors that no longer exist.
item.keycard_bracer.lore: Level 4 clearance, expired. Level 6 clearance, scratched out. Level 9, stained a very specific brown.
item.keycard_bracer.name: Keycard Bracer
item.king_qruies.description: A broad sword with a skull-shaped pommel and a nick at the tip from the last thing it killed.
item.king_qruies.lore: It wants to be used by someone who gets hurt a lot. Take a hit, and the blade adds the pain to its next swing.
item.king_qruies.name: Scarsworn Blade
item.king_qruies.unique: You gain melee damage equal to the last physical damage you took.
item.knucklebone_choker.description: A choker of finger bones, still strung on fishing line.
item.knucklebone_choker.lore: Mutants have too many fingers anyway. Someone had to start counting the spares.
item.knucklebone_choker.name: Knucklebone Choker
item.kuldars_s_scarf.description: A thick, scratchy poncho of knotted wool in dull red and gray.
item.kuldars_s_scarf.lore: It belonged to someone who never took it off, not even indoors. The cold finds you anyway, but now it takes longer.
item.kuldars_s_scarf.name: Ashfall Poncho
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.description: A bulging pouch of dark leather on a thick cord, tied shut with sinew.
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.lore: Its owner was a tribal healer who bled for everyone and then decided to make everyone bleed back.
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.name: Bloodsack Talisman
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.unique: Melee hits cause bleeding that deals damage equal to 100% of your maximum life over 15 seconds.
item.lantern_skull_helm.description: A cannibal skull helm hollowed out to hold a flickering lantern behind the eye sockets.
item.lantern_skull_helm.lore: Cave raiders wore these to be seen coming. Not so much to scare the enemy as to find each other in the dark.
item.lantern_skull_helm.name: Lantern-Skull Helm
item.lantern_skull_helm.unique: Doubles flashlight brightness, cuts battery drain by 40%, and adds 3 m to Sun Flare radius.
item.leather_jacket.description: A black leather jacket, scarred at the elbows and stiff from the cold.
item.leather_jacket.lore: Rides well, wipes clean, and makes a dramatic entrance. Blood comes off leather easier than you would hope.
item.leather_jacket.name: Scarred Biker Jacket
item.leather_mantle.description: A broad leather mantle worn across the shoulders, studded with brass rivets.
item.leather_mantle.lore: Equal parts armor and fashion. The studs give it weight, and the weight gives you a reason to hold your head high.
item.leather_mantle.name: Riveted Hide Mantle
item.lesser_mutated_heart.description: A small, sickly heart that keeps beating long after it should have stopped.
item.lesser_mutated_heart.lore: Harvested from a mutant that lost interest in dying. The taste is exactly what you fear, and the lessons it teaches are real.
item.lesser_mutated_heart.name: Deadspite Heart
item.lesser_mutated_heart.unique: Right-click to consume it and gain experience.
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.descriptio: A tall bow of pale, ash-dusted wood with a string that hums when no one touches it.
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.lore: Legend says the prey picks the hunter. The island seems to have set its mind on you.
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.name: Longbow of the Last Hunt
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.unique: Bow damage is 60% higher, true aim is active, and 30% of shots are not consumed.
item.loop.description: A plain band of tarnished metal, polished smooth by years on someone's finger.
item.loop.lore: Rings have a way of surviving their owners. This one has already survived at least three.
item.loop.name: Tarnished Band
item.madman_s_legacy.description: A scarred round shield with a face scratched into it, grinning and screaming.
item.madman_s_legacy.lore: Passed from one madman to the next. Each added a line to the face. The face now has plenty of lines.
item.madman_s_legacy.name: Scrawlface Shield
item.madman_s_legacy.unique: Frenzy deals +69% more damage per stack.
item.magefist.description: A thick armored glove with scratched marks across the knuckles that flare when clenched.
item.magefist.lore: The marks are an overcharge, a bad idea scribbled onto steel. Power rises fast, and so does the bill.
item.magefist.name: Cinderfist Gauntlet
item.magefist.unique: Your spells deal double damage and cost double energy.
item.magus_necktie.description: A black silk necktie with a silver pin in the shape of an eye.
item.magus_necktie.lore: A bunker interrogator wore it to question captives. It still knows how to tighten.
item.magus_necktie.name: Inquest Necktie
item.manhole_cover_shield.description: A cast-iron manhole cover from the resort road with a strap handle welded to the back.
item.manhole_cover_shield.lore: It weighs as much as a small child and stops about as much as a car door. Nobody has found the hole it came from.
item.manhole_cover_shield.name: Manhole Cover Shield
item.marksmans_case.description: A hard-shell case with a slot for every arrow, each one weighed.
item.marksmans_case.lore: Fewer arrows, better arrows. Every one is a promise.
item.marksmans_case.name: Marksman's Case
item.moon_cuirass.description: Chest armor of pale silver plates that glow softly even under heavy cloud.
item.moon_cuirass.lore: Found in a high cave whose roof was open to the sky. A bow lay beside it, strung, and nobody has dared ask what it was waiting for.
item.moon_cuirass.name: Palelight Cuirass
item.moon_cuirass.unique: A headshot with an arrow lacking Seeking Arrow's homing, from more than 120 feet away, deals five times damage and hits two extra times.
item.moonwalkers.description: Scuffed rubber boots with soles worn smooth on one side.
item.moonwalkers.lore: Whoever made these thought walking forward was overrated. You will feel the same, after you back off a cliff.
item.moonwalkers.name: Backslide Boots
item.moonwalkers.unique: Reverses your movement direction, at 120% of your normal speed.
item.mossweave_tunic.description: A tunic of woven bark fibre with living moss pressed into the seams.
item.mossweave_tunic.lore: Cuts close faster under it. Nobody asks the moss how.
item.mossweave_tunic.name: Mossweave Tunic
item.mothers_beating_pendant.description: A pulsing, fist-sized locket of wet flesh and veined gold. It keeps time with your own heart, a beat behind.
item.mothers_beating_pendant.lore: The caves deeper than the caves give up strange things. This one was warm in the dark, and asked to come along.
item.mothers_beating_pendant.name: Mother's Beating Pendant
item.mothers_beating_pendant.unique: +20% max health, +4 life per second, Healing Dome lasts 10 s longer and restores energy.
item.motorboat_modification_blueprints.d: Water-stained blueprints for a stripped motorboat, margins crammed with angry corrections.
item.motorboat_modification_blueprints.l: Whoever drew these wanted to leave the island at any speed. The notes get less sane toward the bottom.
item.mysterious_robe.description: A deep blue robe woven with threads that flicker like frost under starlight.
item.mysterious_robe.lore: Found folded on a pedestal in a cave no map shows. It is always colder than the room it sits in, and it hums when something unnatural dies nearby.
item.mysterious_robe.name: The Starless Shroud
item.mysterious_robe.unique: Empowers your Cataclysm spell: the vortex turns arcane blue, strikes harder and freezes enemies caught inside.
item.nine_iron_of_last_resort.descriptio: A bent steel golf club wrapped in grip tape and electrical tape.
item.nine_iron_of_last_resort.lore: Sold in the pro shop for four hundred dollars. It has since earned that price back, one skull at a time.
item.nine_iron_of_last_resort.name: Nine Iron of Last Resort
item.old_scroll.description: A brittle roll of waxed paper covered in cramped, faded handwriting.
item.old_scroll.lore: Pulled from a bunker locker that was otherwise full of rations. Whoever wrote it was scared and very good at spelling.
item.old_scroll.name: Locker Scrawl
item.passenger_s_jacket.description: A creased travel jacket with a dead boarding pass still zipped into the pocket.
item.passenger_s_jacket.lore: Its owner was bound for somewhere with a view. The boarding pass lists the window seat, and the window did not hold.
item.passenger_s_jacket.name: Boarding Pass Jacket
item.pelt_shoulderguard.description: A thick deer pelt folded over a plate of hammered tin and strapped under the arm.
item.pelt_shoulderguard.lore: Warm, heavy and smelling faintly of the animal. Snow slides off it, and so do most claws.
item.pelt_shoulderguard.name: Pelt Shoulderguard
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.descri: A black glass pendant holding a tiny silver loop that never stops turning.
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.lore: Its makers died, were revived, and died again, in a cycle that someone kept careful notes about. The notes are missing. The loop is not.
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.name: Everturn Pendant
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.unique: Every time you hit something with a melee or ranged attack, one random spell cooldown is reduced by 1 second.
item.phase_pauldrons.description: Silver pauldrons that shimmer at the edges, as if only half of them are really here.
item.phase_pauldrons.lore: Stamped with serial codes from a lab that no longer exists. When you lift them, the air around your shoulders keeps stepping slightly out of line.
item.phase_pauldrons.name: Flickerplate Pauldrons
item.phase_pauldrons.unique: Blink travels 40 meters farther and strikes every enemy you pass through.
item.phoenix_s_death.description: A greatbow of blackened wood with limbs that glow faintly orange at the tips.
item.phoenix_s_death.lore: The cult burned a bird on this bow for reasons no one remembers. The bow did not forgive the bird, or the fire.
item.phoenix_s_death.name: Ashglow Greatbow
item.phoenix_s_death.unique: Arrows from this greatbow set enemies on fire.
item.pinfeather_quiver.description: A slim quiver of arrows fletched with stiff, narrow feathers.
item.pinfeather_quiver.lore: Thin feathers, thin arrows, through one thing and into the next.
item.pinfeather_quiver.name: Pinfeather Quiver
item.plaid_trousers_of_quiet_rage.descri: Loud plaid golf trousers, torn at the knee and stained in colors the pattern never intended.
item.plaid_trousers_of_quiet_rage.lore: Nobody who wore these has ever shot under par, but they win the arguments.
item.plaid_trousers_of_quiet_rage.name: Plaid Trousers of Quiet Rage
item.pot_lid_shield.description: A dented pot lid with a leather strap bolted to the back.
item.pot_lid_shield.lore: It once covered a stew. Now it covers you. Neither of you smells any better.
item.pot_lid_shield.name: Pot Lid Shield
item.potato_sack.description: A burlap sack with a drawstring top, stuffed with arrows instead of tubers.
item.potato_sack.lore: Nobody ever claimed it was fancy. It holds arrows, and arrows are what matter when the cannibals get close.
item.potato_sack.name: Burlap Arrow Sack
item.precise_adjustments.description: A quiver whose straps are lined with tiny brass dials and tick marks.
item.precise_adjustments.lore: Someone in the buried complex tuned this to the millimeter. They also tuned a whole shelf of tools that shoot back.
item.precise_adjustments.name: Dialwork Quiver
item.precise_adjustments.unique: Focus's attack speed buff lasts 16 seconds longer.
item.printed_kevlar_chaps.description: Cut-resistant chaps extruded from a bunker printer in one gray piece.
item.printed_kevlar_chaps.lore: Rated to stop knives, claws and mild disappointment. Not rated for teeth.
item.printed_kevlar_chaps.name: Printed Kevlar Chaps
item.printed_polymer_chassis.description: A chest plate printed in one piece, still faintly warm and smelling of hot plastic.
item.printed_polymer_chassis.lore: Somebody queued up a thousand of these and then stopped answering the printer. The print log ends mid-sentence.
item.printed_polymer_chassis.name: Printed Polymer Chassis
item.printed_sole_runners.description: Lightweight boots grown layer by layer in a bunker printer, with tread patterns like a circuit board.
item.printed_sole_runners.lore: The soles were printed with the previous owner's footprints. You will leave their tracks, whoever you are.
item.printed_sole_runners.name: Printed Sole Runners
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.description: A silver ring with a polished face that shows your reflection, fractured into pieces.
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.lore: It once belonged to a joker who laughed at everything, even the end. The ring still giggles in the quiet.
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.name: Last Laugh Ring
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.unique: Magic Arrow fires in volleys of 3 extra arrows per cast. Multiple copies stack.
item.purgatory.description: A scorched iron ring etched with tiny flames and an ash-gray stone.
item.purgatory.lore: The cult believed suffering paid for power. This ring keeps the ledger and sends the bill straight to you.
item.purgatory.name: Ashtally Signet
item.purgatory.unique: Purge raises all your damage as your life drops, by up to 300%.
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.descrip: A glass-fronted quiver with arrows that crackle faintly and make your hair stand up.
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.lore: Packed by someone who understood the problem with lightning, which is that you can't carry it. They carried it.
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.name: Quiver of Bottled Lightning
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.unique: +25% pierce chance, Multishot fires 2 more arrows, with damage penalty 10% worse.
item.rabbit_skin_quiver.description: A soft quiver of rabbit fur, stitched tight and lined with grass for quiet storage.
item.rabbit_skin_quiver.lore: A lucky foot hangs from the strap, which is a funny thing to say about the rabbit.
item.rabbit_skin_quiver.name: Hareskin Quiver
item.rage.description: A huge, notched greatsword that seems to hum before it swings.
item.rage.lore: A tribal leader dragged this through the snow for years. When he finally swung it, the people behind him ran.
item.rage.name: Chieftain's Drag
item.rampart_spaulders.description: Broad layered spaulders that close over the neck like a wall.
item.rampart_spaulders.lore: Built for standing in a doorway and not moving.
item.rampart_spaulders.name: Rampart Spaulders
item.rebar_greatsword.description: A rebar rod flattened, ground and wrapped in duct tape.
item.rebar_greatsword.lore: The blade doesn't cut so much as hammer through the problem. The problem rarely objects twice.
item.rebar_greatsword.name: Rebar Greatsword
item.relic_hammer.description: A heavy iron hammer with a cracked head and a haft wrapped in old rope.
item.relic_hammer.lore: Pulled from a ruin that was ancient before the resort was built. It feels less like a tool and more like a decision about to be made.
item.relic_hammer.name: Ironcrack Maul
item.relic_hammer.unique: Hits slow the enemy they strike.
item.rendered_fat_hauberk.description: A cuirass layered with hardened fat from some enormous, long-dead hulk.
item.rendered_fat_hauberk.lore: It wobbles when you walk and bounces blades like wet clay. The smell is also a weapon.
item.rendered_fat_hauberk.name: Rendered-Fat Hauberk
item.revving_fury.description: A chainsaw lashed to a long pole, with a fraying pull cord.
item.revving_fury.lore: Its engine screams at the same pitch as the things it hunts. The two share the same language.
item.revving_fury.name: Revving Fury
item.revving_fury.unique: +35% attack speed, but attacks cost 40% more stamina.
item.ring_of_seven_bites.description: A tarnished ring pitted with the tiny tooth marks of seven different jaws.
item.ring_of_seven_bites.lore: Each bite was a different attempt to take it back. Each owner died with a different smile.
item.ring_of_seven_bites.name: Ring of Seven Bites
item.ring_of_seven_bites.unique: +12% damage and +20% chance to bleed on hit, but you take 10% more damage.
item.riot_door_shield.description: A slab of reinforced bunker door with a viewport slit and one bent hinge.
item.riot_door_shield.lore: Four people couldn't shut this door against what was behind it. It turns out one person can hold it open indefinitely.
item.riot_door_shield.name: Riot Door Shield
item.rippers_cleaver.description: A butcher's cleaver rebuilt with a serrated spine for tearing, not cutting.
item.rippers_cleaver.lore: Made for flesh that grows back wrong. The blade has learned which kind of meat to hate.
item.rippers_cleaver.name: Ripper's Cleaver
item.rusty_polearm.description: A pole with a rust-brown spearhead tied on with wire and fishing line.
item.rusty_polearm.lore: Not much of a weapon, but it keeps things at arm's length plus a bit. In the woods, that is a lot.
item.rusty_polearm.name: Wirebound Spear
item.sacrificial_kris.description: A wavy-bladed ritual dagger with a handle wrapped in cult banner cloth.
item.sacrificial_kris.lore: Cut once for the ritual, twice for the silence, three times for whoever disagreed.
item.sacrificial_kris.name: Cult Ritual Knife
item.sacrificial_kris.unique: +12% crit chance and +80% crit damage, but -10% maximum health.
item.scarf.description: A thick cotton bandana, knotted at the back and long past washing.
item.scarf.lore: Someone made this with love and a rough sense of gauge. It keeps your neck warm, and the people who want your neck at bay.
item.scarf.name: Tallymark Bandana
item.scroll_of_recovery.description: A small folded note sealed with candle wax and a smear of something that smells like pine sap.
item.scroll_of_recovery.lore: Kelvin carried one and could not read it. Still, he guarded it like it was the last bandage on the island.
item.scroll_of_recovery.name: Pinesap Note
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.descript: A frost-brittle transcript that hums faintly when held near an open window.
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.lore: Seven voices were recorded on it. Six of them could not hold the note, and the seventh is still holding it.
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.name: Frozen Voices Transcript
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.unique: Snow Storm gains 5 max charge (longer and wider), and Snap Freeze deals 1.5 more times spell damage.
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.description: A fine-balanced axe with a scope sight bolted to the blade.
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.lore: She never missed, so the axe never needed to be heavy. It still can't be put down.
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.name: Deadeye Hatchet
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.unique: Pistol damage is multiplied by 6 and pistol critical hit chance increases by 50%.
item.shield.description: A plain round shield of nailed oak boards, banded with iron.
item.shield.lore: Nothing fancy, and nothing about it is meant to be. It gets one job and does it faithfully until the day it doesn't.
item.shield.name: Oakboard Shield
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.descri: A battered riot shield with scorched handprints along the grip, none of them yours.
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.lore: Rumor has it a survivor held this against the first wave and then refused to put it down. Their hands are still on it.
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.name: Shield of the First Survivor
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.unique: Parry's window lasts twice as long, parry has a chance to trigger when you are hit, and its radius is 3 m larger.
item.sigil_ring_of_the_nameless_flock.de: A black iron ring stamped with an eye inside an eye inside an eye.
item.sigil_ring_of_the_nameless_flock.lo: Handed out at the third ceremony. Nobody remembers the first two, which is considered part of the initiation.
item.silver_locket_of_agility.descriptio: A silver locket shaped like a swallow in mid-flight, hung on a thin chain.
item.silver_locket_of_agility.lore: Swallows leave before the cold comes. Anyone who wears this is invited to do the same, and a few have taken the hint.
item.silver_locket_of_agility.name: Pewter Sprinter Locket
item.sinewlaced_boots.description: Hide boots laced up the shin with dried sinew, the soles patched with strips of tyre.
item.sinewlaced_boots.lore: Whoever made them tied every knot twice. The second knot is the reason they are still walking around.
item.sinewlaced_boots.name: Sinewlaced Boots
item.sled_runner_boots.description: Boots fitted with bolt-on steel runners for skating over packed snow.
item.sled_runner_boots.lore: Invented after the third failed sled. The first two are still somewhere down the mountain.
item.sled_runner_boots.name: Sled Runner Boots
item.smasher.description: A huge hammer with a head cast from a car's engine block.
item.smasher.lore: Forged in the resort's ruined garage by someone with a grudge and a welding torch. It does one thing.
item.smasher.name: Blockhead Sledge
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.description: A weathered quiver burned black at the rim and carved with sooty tally marks.
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.lore: It came through three fires and an argument with a bear. The smell never quite left the leather, and neither did the luck.
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.name: Tallyflame Quiver
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.unique: Crossbows fire 2.5 times as fast and deal 400% more damage.
item.soulstring.description: A pale greatbow strung with something thin, red and flexible that is definitely not cord.
item.soulstring.lore: It drinks a little of each shot from whoever draws it. Everyone who has held it agrees it is not a metaphor.
item.soulstring.name: Veinstring Bow
item.soulstring.unique: Blood Infused Arrow deals bonus damage for every point of life it consumes.
item.spell_scroll.description: A bundle of waxed paper sealed with dark wax, covered in cramped, faintly glowing handwriting.
item.spell_scroll.lore: Reading it aloud is optional. The notes read you either way, and the cost is a headache and a little more fate.
item.spell_scroll.name: Sealed Field Notes
item.spiked_cleats.description: Waterproof golf shoes with replacement spikes screwed in by someone who clearly meant it.
item.spiked_cleats.lore: The spikes are not standard issue. Neither are the stains on them.
item.spiked_cleats.name: Spiked Cleats
item.spotters_cap.description: A peaked cap with a cracked lens clipped to the brim.
item.spotters_cap.lore: One eye on the target, one eye on the lens. It helps more than it should.
item.spotters_cap.name: Spotter's Cap
item.springheel_wraps.description: Cloth wraps over coiled bedsprings, tied at the ankle.
item.springheel_wraps.lore: The first jump is a surprise. So is the landing.
item.springheel_wraps.name: Springheel Wraps
item.steel_ring_of_agility.description: A narrow steel ring, perfectly round and perfectly light.
item.steel_ring_of_agility.lore: Thieves swear it improves their luck, and soldiers swear it improves their aim. The ring has never said which of them is lying.
item.steel_ring_of_agility.name: Rebar Sprinter Ring
item.steelweave_gloves.description: Work gloves with a lining of fine steel mesh and taped-over knuckles.
item.steelweave_gloves.lore: Made for handling sheet metal in the maintenance tunnels. They handle cannibals about as well.
item.steelweave_gloves.name: Steelweave Gloves
item.sunscorched_cap.description: A faded baseball cap, its brim stiff with salt and sweat.
item.sunscorched_cap.lore: Left in the resort lobby beside an empty champagne flute. It makes you feel strangely confident and a little bit sunburned.
item.sunscorched_cap.name: Salt-Brim Cap
item.sword_devil_s_scarf.description: A crimson collar embroidered with tiny crossed swords and a horned grin.
item.sword_devil_s_scarf.lore: Said to have belonged to a duelist who never lost. Now it lies on the ground, and he lies elsewhere.
item.sword_devil_s_scarf.name: Redgrin Collar
item.tallow_almanac.description: A greasy almanac of candle-lit notes on timing and rest.
item.tallow_almanac.lore: Every page says the same thing: wait a little less.
item.tallow_almanac.name: Tallow Almanac
item.the_great_iron_horn.description: A massive iron horn engraved with battle scenes, its mouthpiece worn smooth by countless lips.
item.the_great_iron_horn.lore: When it sounds, the cannibals go quiet and the mutants answer. Every echo it makes is a roll call of the people who didn't live to hear it again.
item.the_great_iron_horn.name: The Muster Horn
item.the_great_iron_horn.unique: When you use Warcry, you and your allies gain armor equal to 10% of your armor and also gain bonus damage resistance.
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.descr: A plain gold band that is heavier than any ring has a right to be.
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.lore: Every power on the island has wanted it at some point. It wants a bearer that can keep pace with its ambitions, and it is not picky about the cost.
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.name: The Gnawing Band
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.uniqu: Wearing it draws the hungry attention of an unknown entity that begins to hunt you.
item.the_seventh_page.description: A single sheet of unnatural paper that always looks like it is yours to read.
item.the_seventh_page.lore: The first six pages were burned. This one burned the reader. It is still looking for a new one.
item.the_seventh_page.name: The Seventh Page
item.the_seventh_page.unique: Cataclysm turns arcane, deals 10 more times spell damage and lasts 4 s longer, but all cooldowns are 25% longer.
A page of singed paper with a single point of bright ink at its center.
A lone engineer wrote this in the dark of the complex, after the lights died. The last line says only: do not look away.
If a black hole hits 5 or more enemies in its lifetime, it releases a ball lightning when it ends.
item.thick_rubber_glove.description: A heavy yellow rubber glove, the kind used to scrub things that should stay scrubbed.
item.thick_rubber_glove.lore: Found beside a drain in the ruined resort. Nobody knows what it was cleaning, and you have chosen not to ask the drain.
item.thick_rubber_glove.name: Scrubber's Mitt
item.thornhide_mantle.description: A hide mantle studded with thorns, points out.
item.thornhide_mantle.lore: Hugs are rare. Grabs are rarer.
item.thornhide_mantle.name: Thornhide Mantle
item.thornmail.description: Heavy chest armor covered in jagged iron barbs, wired on by hand.
item.thornmail.lore: Made by a survivor who decided hugging distance was the best strategy. Hugs last a short time and end badly.
item.thornmail.name: Wirebound Hauberk
item.tiara.description: A thin silver tiara with a crack down one stone, still sparkling in bad light.
item.tiara.lore: Left behind in the ruined resort, probably by someone who was sure the rescue boat was coming. The sparkle remains optimistic.
item.tiara.name: Lobby Diadem
item.tiara.unique: It does nothing but shine. Looking good is its own reward.
item.toxic_ring.description: A green-stained ring set with a vial of something that bubbles when you flinch.
item.toxic_ring.lore: The wearer is expected to be careful. The wearer before you was not, and the stain on the finger bone proves the point.
item.toxic_ring.name: Sporevial Ring
item.toxic_ring.unique: Gives you a chance on hit to make enemies bleed.
item.traders_puffer_jacket.description: A bright orange puffer jacket, patched with tape and stuffed with questionable feathers.
item.traders_puffer_jacket.lore: Warm enough for the mountain, loud enough to bring every predator within a mile.
item.traders_puffer_jacket.name: Trader's Puffer Jacket
item.travel_band.description: A narrow silver ring etched with the outline of a staircase.
item.travel_band.lore: Made for people who needed to be somewhere else, right now. It never says where.
item.travel_band.name: Stairwell Band
item.tribal_necklace.description: Knotted sinew strung with carved bone and painted wood beads.
item.tribal_necklace.lore: Each bead is a kill, and each knot is a promise to the next one.
item.tribal_necklace.name: Killtally Necklace
item.tribal_necklace.unique: Raises your maximum Frenzy stacks by 3.
item.twin_skull_pauldrons.description: Two bleached skulls, hollowed and lashed to a leather yoke with sinew.
item.twin_skull_pauldrons.lore: They were a twin set once, which made them worth hunting. The pair now wins every staring contest.
item.twin_skull_pauldrons.name: Twin-Skull Pauldrons
item.twine_charm.description: A knot of fishing twine and a bottle cap, worn on a cord.
item.twine_charm.lore: Nobody remembers who tied the first one. Everybody ties the second.
item.twine_charm.name: Twine Charm
item.undying_promise.description: Black leggings sewn with a thin red thread that seems to move on its own.
item.undying_promise.lore: Someone swore never to die while a debt was owed. Death took the debt seriously.
item.undying_promise.name: Bloodsworn Legguards
item.undying_promise.unique: Once every 60 seconds, survive a lethal hit.
item.unnamed.description: Frayed dark leggings stitched with jagged crimson lines.
item.unnamed.lore: Cut from the pants of someone who never stopped moving. Wear them and you won't either.
item.unnamed.name: Ragewalker Leggings
item.unnamed.unique: While Frenzy is active, +5% critical hit chance and +3% attack speed.
item.unnamed_2.description: A huge greatsword with a blade pitted by rage and rimmed in dried blood.
item.unnamed_2.lore: Drawn only as a last resort, and it never fails. It has simply never stopped.
item.unnamed_2.name: Redrim Reckoner
item.unnamed_5.description: A pulsing red amulet shaped like a heart with a spike through it.
item.unnamed_5.lore: Made from a rampaging mutant's heart, or so its seller said. It still beats during fights.
item.unnamed_5.name: The Pierced Heart
item.unnamed_5.unique: Melee and ranged damage doubled, and Berserk grants +15% attack speed and +30% movement speed.
item.unnamed_6.description: A pale bracer engraved with a protective dome and etched healing marks.
item.unnamed_6.lore: Worn by a bunker medic who stood in the open and told everyone else to get behind her.
item.unnamed_6.name: Lastward Cuff
item.unnamed_6.unique: Healing Dome cooldown rate +100% and its spell cost reduced by 40%.
item.vampire_ring.description: A black ring set with a ruby that slowly swells and shrinks.
item.vampire_ring.lore: The stone is never empty and never full. The tribes bury the hands of those who wear it.
item.vampire_ring.name: Bloatstone Ring
item.vampire_ring.unique: Heals you for 6% of the damage you deal, and for 5% of your maximum life on each kill.
item.vestment_of_the_quiet_choir.descrip: Ash-gray cult smock lined with stitched slips of paper.
item.vestment_of_the_quiet_choir.lore: The slips are all the same sentence, written thousands of times: 'Please let it be quiet now.'
item.vestment_of_the_quiet_choir.name: Hushed Smock
item.wardpaint_shield.description: A plank shield daubed with warding signs in red clay.
item.wardpaint_shield.lore: The signs do nothing against a club. Against everything else, they help.
item.wardpaint_shield.name: Wardpaint Shield
item.weathered_dog_tags.description: Two dented dog tags with the name scratched out and a small note taped between them.
item.weathered_dog_tags.lore: The note reads, in block capitals, 'FOLLOW ORDERS.' It does not say whose.
item.weathered_dog_tags.name: Weathered Dog Tags
item.welders_gloves.description: Scorched leather gloves still smelling of solder and burnt rubber.
item.welders_gloves.lore: Found on a workbench in the bunker, next to a half-finished something that was clearly not an invention.
item.welders_gloves.name: Welder's Gloves
item.wind_armor.description: Light chest armor of overlapping gray plates that flutter and shift like feathers.
item.wind_armor.lore: Salvaged from the glider crash site, where someone fell for a very long time. The armor remembers moving fast.
item.wind_armor.name: Wreckwing Cuirass
item.wind_armor.unique: Dodging an attack gives +20% movement speed, +35% damage and +2000 armor, and heals 5% of your maximum life.
item.withered_crown.description: A crown of dry thorny twigs, brittle and gray, with dark stains in the bark.
item.withered_crown.lore: The doomsday cult's idea of royalty. It still catches blood, and what it catches does not stay put.
item.withered_crown.name: Ashthorn Circlet
item.withered_crown.unique: One cast of Blood Infused Arrow affects 4 additional projectiles.
item.wormhole_stabilizators.description: Heavy brass-and-wire bracers humming with a faint, uneasy pitch.
item.wormhole_stabilizators.lore: Salvaged from the buried complex, where something was being held open that should have stayed shut. They were never powered down.
item.wormhole_stabilizators.name: Rifthold Bracers
item.worn_bracer.description: A scuffed leather bracer, buckles polished by constant use.
item.worn_bracer.lore: Nothing glamorous. It protects the arm you swing with, which is arguably the one that matters.
item.worn_bracer.name: Scuffed Bracer
item.worn_shorts.description: Faded cotton shorts with a frayed hem and one pocket left.
item.worn_shorts.lore: Summer clothing on a winter island. Whoever owned these either planned very badly or had the island plan for them.
item.worn_shorts.name: Faded Cutoffs
item.yorium_s_assault.description: Spiked steel gauntlets fused with leather straps that never loosen.
item.yorium_s_assault.lore: The oath's last gift to the world was a long line of broken faces.
item.yorium_s_assault.name: Blood Oath Grips
item.yorium_s_assault.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_burden.description: Huge, jagged pauldrons forged to make the wearer look larger than they are.
item.yorium_s_burden.lore: Every grudge got carried on these shoulders. They weigh more than they look.
item.yorium_s_burden.name: Oathbound Pauldrons
item.yorium_s_burden.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_gaze.description: A grim steel helm with a single narrow eye slit and a spike on the crown.
item.yorium_s_gaze.lore: Whoever swore the oath never blinked in a fight. Behind this helm, you can't either.
item.yorium_s_gaze.name: Blood Oath Visor
item.yorium_s_gaze.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_resolve.description: Thick steel bracers with studs along the forearm.
item.yorium_s_resolve.lore: Strapped on so tight they cut the circulation. Resolve, apparently, is pain tolerance.
item.yorium_s_resolve.name: Bloodsworn Bracers
item.yorium_s_resolve.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.description: A blackened steel cuirass with sharp spikes along the ribs.
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.lore: Built for a warrior who gave no quarter and asked for none. The first part held up better.
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.name: Blood Oath Plate
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yuki_onna_greaves.description: White silk leggings, stiff with frost and cold to the touch.
item.yuki_onna_greaves.lore: Never wet, never warm. The tribes tell their children not to look at them after dark.
item.yuki_onna_greaves.name: Whiteout Legwraps
item.yuki_onna_kimono.description: A long white wrap embroidered with drifting snowflakes.
item.yuki_onna_kimono.lore: Found folded on a rock at the top of a blizzard. The rock was empty. The wrap was not.
item.yuki_onna_kimono.name: Whiteout Wrap
item.yuki_onna_s_headdress.description: A crown of ice-white combs and pale thread, always cold to the touch.
item.yuki_onna_s_headdress.lore: Wear it and the wind starts speaking to you in a woman's voice. It never says anything friendly.
item.yuki_onna_s_headdress.name: Whiteout Coronet
item.yuki_onna_strides.description: Pale, soft-soled boots that leave no tracks in snow.
item.yuki_onna_strides.lore: The snow woman walks and the ground forgets her. Follow the missing footprints at your own risk.
item.yuki_onna_strides.name: Whiteout Treads
item.zipline_grippers.description: Rubber-grip boots with a clip for ziplines and a hook for anything unlucky.
item.zipline_grippers.lore: Tried and tested on the long line over the bay. The test subject did not come back for a refund.
item.zipline_grippers.name: Zipline Grippers
item.zipline_grippers.unique: +1 jump power and you can bunny hop.

perk.corrosive_skin.flavor: Touch me and your gear rots.

perk.counter_strike.effect: Parrying stores bonus melee damage for 20 seconds, equal to 150% of the parry's damage. Spent on your next melee attack.
perk.counter_strike.flavor: Let them hit you. Then return the favor.
perk.counter_strike.name: Grudge Bank
perk.craftable_plane_axe.effect: Unlocks crafting of the Rescue Axe: 1 crafted axe, 1 rope and 2 sticks.
perk.craftable_plane_axe.flavor: Emergency gear, now with a handle you can trust.

spell.ball_lightning.description: Releases a crackling orb that deals 1,220 base damage plus 75x spell damage, and can crit with the right gear. 350 energy, 100 s cooldown.
spell.ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
spell.bash.description: A shield-first slam that slows enemies by 40% for 2 s and makes them take 30% more damage. Gear adds bleed and lifesteal. 25 energy, 25 s cooldown.
spell.bash.name: Bash
spell.berserk.description: Fly into a 30 s rage: +30% damage, +35% movement speed and +25% attack speed, at the cost of your max health. 10 energy, 200 s cooldown.
spell.berserk.name: Berserk
spell.black_flame.description: Toggle a cold black fire that damages nearby enemies steadily, scaling with spell damage (x0.4). Keep it lit as long as your energy lasts. 25 energy, 2.5 s cooldown.
spell.black_flame.name: Black Flame
spell.black_hole.description: Tears open a 15 m gravity well for 9 s that drags enemies to its core and crushes them with heavy magic damage scaling with spell damage. 350 energy, 140 s cooldown.
spell.black_hole.name: Black Hole
spell.blink.description: Teleport up to 15 m in the direction you face. Great for dodging, awful for dignity. Gear can extend range or make arrival explosive. 25 energy, 14 s cooldown.
spell.blink.name: Blink
spell.blood_infused_arrow.description: Pay with your own health to loose a blood arrow whose damage grows with the life you sacrifice, plus a spell damage bonus. Painful, effective. 75 energy, 8 s cooldown.
spell.blood_infused_arrow.name: Blood Infused Arrow
spell.cataclysm.description: Calls down a 12 s vortex of 5 m radius that grinds everything inside for 40 damage plus 25x spell damage. The island's loudest apology. 500 energy, 300 s cooldown.
spell.cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
spell.firebolt.description: Lobs a quick fire bolt for 1.2x spell damage, igniting what it hits. The first spell every survivor learns, and the one they never stop using. 45 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.firebolt.name: Firebolt
spell.flicker_strike.description: Blink from enemy to enemy within 20 m, up to eight, then back to where you stood. A heartbeat later every one of them is cut at once. Each enemy in the chain makes every cut hit harder. 120 energy, 45 s cooldown.
spell.flicker_strike.name: Flicker Strike
spell.focus.description: Steady your breath: headshots hit +50% harder and body shots +15%, slowing aimed targets by 80% for 4 s. 40 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.focus.name: Focus
spell.frenzy.description: Free to cast. Each hit stacks +2% attack speed and +7.5% damage, up to 5 stacks, until you stop swinging. 0 energy, 40 s cooldown.
spell.frenzy.name: Frenzy
spell.golden_skin.description: Plates your body in living gold for a stretch of near-invulnerable armor. Slow, shiny, hard to kill. 65 energy, 160 s cooldown.
spell.golden_skin.name: Golden Skin
spell.healing_dome.description: Raises a glowing dome for 10 s that mends everyone standing inside it. A moving field hospital, if the patients stay put. 80 energy, 70 s cooldown.
spell.healing_dome.name: Healing Dome
spell.magic_arrow.description: Looses one huge arcane bolt dealing 4.2x spell damage, with a 10 s lingering effect. Perks can turn it into a volley. 100 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
spell.multishot.description: Toggle: every shot fans into extra projectiles at a 25% damage penalty each. Drains 30 energy per use, and gear can add more arrows. 12 s cooldown.
spell.multishot.name: Multishot
spell.parry.description: Strike everything within 3.5 m for 40 damage plus 3x spell damage, gain +1 attack speed for 10 s, and shrug off the next blow within 1.5 s. 35 energy, 60 s cooldown.
spell.parry.name: Parry
spell.portal.description: Tears a doorway through the island that stays open for 30 s, letting you and your companions cross it freely. 90 energy, 60 s cooldown.
spell.portal.name: Portal
spell.purge.description: Cleanses debuffs from everything within 30 m. Perks make it heal you or amplify your damage for a time. 40 energy, 16 s cooldown.
spell.purge.name: Purge
spell.roaring_cheeks.description: A thunderous blast of foul wind: 30 m radius, hard knockback, 80% slow for 30 s and 50 base damage plus 5x spell damage. Nobody wins. 400 energy, 360 s cooldown.
spell.roaring_cheeks.name: Roaring Cheeks
spell.seeking_arrow.description: Fires a homing arrow that hunts the nearest enemy in view for 10 s and slows its victim by 90% for 4 s. 50 energy, 5 s cooldown.
spell.seeking_arrow.name: Seeking Arrow
spell.snap_freeze.description: Flash-freezes enemies within 12 m for 7 s and deals 6.5x spell damage as they shatter against the cold. 220 energy, 40 s cooldown.
spell.snap_freeze.name: Snap Freeze
spell.snow_storm.description: Summons a whirling blizzard that chews through enemies in its area, scaling x0.4 with spell damage per charge, up to 10 charges. 120 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.snow_storm.name: Snow Storm
spell.sun_flare.description: Hurls a false sun that burns for 20 s over an 8.5 m area: enemies inside are slowed by 40% and scorched, while allies are mended. 100 energy, 70 s cooldown.
spell.sun_flare.name: Sun Flare
spell.sustain_shield.description: Channel to build a barrier at 3 points per second, up to a cap of 15, which lingers 20 s after you stop. Drains 50 energy for every second held.
spell.sustain_shield.name: Sustain Shield
spell.taunt.description: Insults everything in earshot so it charges you instead of your friends. Great way to hold a line, or lose one. 40 energy, 45 s cooldown.
spell.taunt.name: Taunt
spell.war_cry.description: A bellow across 50 m that rallies you and nearby allies: 20% more attack speed and 20% more damage for the duration. 85 energy, 180 s cooldown.
spell.war_cry.name: War Cry
spell.wide_reach.description: Gathers dropped loot within 5.5 m: materials always, other items if they are at least as rare as your worst equipped piece, plus loose sticks, stones, herbs and similar. Not while pushing a sled. 10 energy, 0.4 s cooldown.
spell.wide_reach.name: Wide Reach

ui.guide.enemies.body:
Enemies match the level of the players near them. The game's difficulty adds levels and makes elites more common.

Elites, minibosses and bosses are tougher and use abilities, named on their nameplate. Look at an enemy to read more about it.
ui.guide.enemies.title: Enemies
ui.guide.keys.footer: Change any key in the settings menu ({0}). On a gamepad, LB + Select opens it.
ui.guide.keys.title: Keys
ui.guide.levels.body:
Kills give XP. Kill again quickly to build a massacre streak: the XP is banked and multiplied when the streak ends.

Each level gives a perk point and raises your attributes. Dying costs part of the XP in your current level, never a level.
ui.guide.levels.title: Levels and XP
ui.guide.loot.body:
Enemies drop gear when they die; elites and bosses drop more. Walk over a drop to pick it up.

Rarity sets how strong the rolls are: Common (white), Magic (blue), Rare (yellow) and Legendary (red). Uniques are Legendary and carry a special effect. Magic find raises the rarity of drops.
ui.guide.loot.title: Loot
ui.guide.merge.body:
Turn spare gear into better gear. Select an item in the bag and press Merge, next to Sort. Items that cannot join it fade; click the ones you want to give up, then press Merge again.

3 Common of one item type make 1 Magic of that type, 5 Magic make 1 Rare, and 7 Rare make 1 Legendary. Any 3 Legendary items make 1 random Legendary of another kind. The new item takes the lowest level of the ones used and fresh stats, and lands where your first pick was, marked NEW. Cancel stops merging.
ui.guide.merge.title: Merge
ui.guide.perks.body:
Spend perk points in the perk tree ({0}). Some perks unlock spells: put them on the spell bar and cast them with the spell keys.

Spells cost energy, which is your stamina bar, and each has a cooldown.
ui.guide.perks.title: Perks and spells
ui.guide.welcome.body:
An RPG layer over the island. Every enemy has a level, many are elites with abilities, and every kill gives XP. Levels give perk points, and enemies drop gear with rolled stats.

Turn the pages for the keys and each system. This tab is always here.

ui.sheet.tip.agility: Raises ranged damage and max energy.
ui.sheet.tip.armor: Physical damage reduction from armor = (armor ÷ (armor + 500))², so each point is worth less than the last.
ui.sheet.tip.armor_piercing: Flat armor your melee hits ignore on the target (ranged hits: {0}).
ui.sheet.tip.attack_speed: Change in how fast you swing and shoot.
ui.sheet.tip.bleed_chance: Chance a hit makes the enemy bleed: damage over time.
ui.sheet.tip.block: Flat damage removed from every hit you take (after armor).
ui.sheet.tip.cooldown: Change in how long spells take to be ready again: cooldown multiplier ÷ cooldown rate.
ui.sheet.tip.crit_chance: Chance that a hit is a critical hit.
ui.sheet.tip.crit_damage: Extra damage a critical hit deals on top of the normal hit.
ui.sheet.tip.dodge: Chance that an incoming hit misses you completely.
ui.sheet.tip.energy_on_hit: Energy you get back every time one of your hits lands (melee hits also give stamina back).
ui.sheet.tip.energy_regen: Change in how fast energy refills: Intelligence × energy per Intelligence × recovery multiplier × regen rate. Flat bonus: {0}/s.
ui.sheet.tip.explosion_damage: Extra damage of explosives and thrown hits (shared with your party in co-op).
ui.sheet.tip.extra_levels: Levels the host added to every enemy.
ui.sheet.tip.fire_damage: Extra damage dealt as burning, as a share of the hit, to enemies you set on fire.
ui.sheet.tip.fire_resist: Less damage from burning and fire.
ui.sheet.tip.game_difficulty: Set by the game's own difficulty: it adds enemy levels and elites on top of the players' level.
ui.sheet.tip.headshot: Multiplies a ranged hit to the head.
ui.sheet.tip.health_on_hit: Health you recover every time one of your hits lands.
ui.sheet.tip.health_regen: (0.25% of max health + flat regen) × regen rate × recovery multiplier, on top of the game's own regeneration.
ui.sheet.tip.intelligence: Raises spell damage and energy recovery.
ui.sheet.tip.jump: Change in how high you jump.
ui.sheet.tip.magic_find: Raises the rarity of items that drop.
ui.sheet.tip.magic_reduction: 1 − damage taken multiplier × magic damage taken multiplier. Armor does not apply to magic.
ui.sheet.tip.massacre_time: How long a kill streak lasts after a kill (longest wait). Each kill adds {0}s; the banked XP pays out when it runs out.
ui.sheet.tip.max_energy: (100 + Agility × energy per point + flat bonuses) × max energy multiplier. Spells spend it.
ui.sheet.tip.max_health: (100 + Vitality × health per point + flat bonuses) × max health multiplier.
ui.sheet.tip.melee_damage: All-damage × melee bonus × (1 + Strength × melee damage per Strength). Multiplies the weapon's base damage.
ui.sheet.tip.melee_flat: Added to the weapon's base damage before the melee multiplier.
ui.sheet.tip.move_speed: Change in how fast you walk and run.
ui.sheet.tip.physical_reduction: 1 − damage taken multiplier × (1 − armor reduction). What you do not take from physical hits.
ui.sheet.tip.pierce: How well your projectiles punch through what they hit.
ui.sheet.tip.projectile_size: Change in the size of your projectiles: bigger ones hit more easily.
ui.sheet.tip.projectile_speed: Change in how fast your arrows and bolts fly.
ui.sheet.tip.ranged_damage: All-damage × ranged bonus × (1 + Agility × ranged damage per Agility). Bows, guns and thrown weapons.
ui.sheet.tip.ranged_flat: Added to each projectile's base damage before the ranged multiplier.
ui.sheet.tip.shield: Absorbs damage before your health: Sustain Shield while channeled and the dodge shield from perks.
ui.sheet.tip.slow_chance: Chance a hit slows the enemy for a while.
ui.sheet.tip.spell_cost: Change in the energy every spell costs.
ui.sheet.tip.spell_damage: All-damage × spell bonus × (1 + Intelligence × spell damage per Intelligence).
ui.sheet.tip.spell_flat: Spells scale with this: most deal base + a multiple of it, before the spell multiplier.
ui.sheet.tip.strength: Raises melee damage (1 + Strength × the melee bonus per point). Each level also adds attribute points.
ui.sheet.tip.thorns: Damage reflected to the enemy that hits you in melee.
ui.sheet.tip.vitality: Raises max health (base 100 + Vitality × health per point, then the max health multiplier).
ui.sheet.tip.weaken_chance: Chance a hit weakens the enemy: it takes more damage for a while.
